meta.title: A Day with Ranger Mark
meta.textType: functional: a typical day, a blog post

paragraphs: Posted by Mia. On Saturday, July eleventh, the Explorers visited the nature park, and I met Ranger Mark. Teacher Kim, Lily, Leo, and May came with me. Ranger Mark wears a green cap and brown boots. He looks after the wildlife in the park. He also helps people to love nature. This post tells about his day. Teacher Kim read my post first, and then she put it on the blog.

Ranger Mark gets up at five o'clock. After he eats breakfast, he goes to the park. He opens the gate at half past six. Before the visitors come, he walks along the main path. The path is four kilometers long. Then he checks the lake and the area around it. "What time is the first tour?" I asked. "It is at ten o'clock," said Ranger Mark. At ten o'clock, he takes visitors on a forest tour. He carries binoculars and a small bag of equipment. We followed him and looked up into the trees. The birds sang loudly, and the air smelled fresh.

At midday, he eats lunch under a big tree. He also writes in his small logbook. After lunch, he climbs the lookout tower and counts birds. He writes the number of birds in his logbook. Then he looks at the lake from the tower. Before he goes home, he checks the path again. At five o'clock, he closes the gate. His working hours are long. He works for more than ten hours every day.

"What do you like best about your job?" I asked. "I like to see a new bird," said Ranger Mark. He smiled, and I took a photo of him at the gate. I love animals, so I think this is a wonderful job. Which job do you like? What time does your day begin? Please tell us in the comments.
text.summary: Mia writes a blog post about a day with Ranger Mark in the nature park. She tells what time he gets up, opens the gate, walks the path, and counts birds.
